Alif Laam Meem Raa. Yeh kitaab-e-Khuda ki aayatein hain, aur jo kuch bhi aap ke Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai woh sab barhaq hai, lekin logon ki aksariyat imaan laane waali nahin hai

Allah hi woh hai jis ne aasmaanon ko baghair kisi sutoon ke buland kar diya hai jaisa ke tum dekh rahe ho. Us ke baad us ne Arsh par iqtidaar qaaim kiya aur aaftaab o maahtaab ko musakhkhar banaaya ke sab ek mu'ayyana muddat tak chalte rahenge. Wahi tamaam umoor ki tadbeer karne waala hai aur apni aayaat ko mufassal taur se bayaan karta hai ke shaayad tum log Parwardigar ki mulaaqaat ka yaqeen paida kar lo

Woh Khuda woh hai jis ne zameen ko phailaaya aur us mein atal qism ke pahaad qaraar diye aur nahrein jaari keen, aur har phal ka joda qaraar diya. Woh raat ke parde se din ko dhaank deta hai, aur is mein saahibaan-e-fikr o nazar ke liye badi nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur zameen ke muta'addid tukde aapas mein ek doosre se mile hue hain, aur angoor ke baaghaat hain aur zara'at hai aur khajoorein hain jin mein ba'z do shaakh ki hain aur ba'z ek shaakh ki hain, aur sab ek hi paani se seenche jaate hain, aur hum ba'z ko ba'z par khaane mein tarjeeh dete hain, aur is mein bhi saahibaan-e-aql ke liye badi nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur agar tumhein kisi baat par ta'ajjub hai to ta'ajjub ki baat un logon ka yeh qaul hai ke kya hum khaak ho jaane ke baad bhi naye sire se dobaara paida kiye jaayenge? Yahi woh log hain jinhon ne apne Parwardigar ka inkaar kiya hai, aur unhi ki gardanon mein tauq daale jaayenge, aur yahi ahl-e-Jahannam hain aur isi mein hamesha rehne waale hain

Aur ae Rasool! Yeh log aap se bhalaai se pehle hi buraai (azaab) chaahte hain, jab ke un se pehle bahut si azaab ki nazeerein guzar chuki hain, aur aap ka Parwardigar logon ke liye un ke zulm par bakhshne waala bhi hai aur bahut sakht azaab karne waala bhi hai
Aur yeh kaafir kehte hain ke un ke oopar koi nishaani (hamaari matlooba) kyon nahin naazil hoti? To aap keh dijiye ke main sirf daraane waala hoon, aur har qaum ke liye ek haadi aur rehbar hai
Allah behtar jaanta hai ke har aurat ke shikam mein kya hai aur us ke reham mein kya kami aur ziyaadati hoti rehti hai, aur har shai ki us ke nazdeek ek miqdaar mu'ayyan hai
Woh ghaaib o haazir sab ka jaanne waala buzurg o baalaatar hai
Us ke nazdeek tum mein se sab baraabar hain, jo baat aahista kahe aur jo buland aawaaz se kahe, aur jo raat mein chhupa rahe aur din mein chalta rahe

Us ke liye saamne aur peechhe se muhaafiz taaqatein hain jo hukm-e-Khuda se us ki hifaazat karti hain, aur Khuda kisi qaum ke haalaat ko us waqt tak nahin badalta jab tak woh khud apne ko tabdeel na kar le, aur jab Khuda kisi qaum par azaab ka iraada kar leta hai to koi taal nahin sakta hai, aur na us ke ilaawa koi kisi ka waali o sarparast hai
Wahi Khuda hai jo tumhein daraane aur laalach dilaane ke liye bijliyaan dikhaata hai aur paani se lade hue bojhal baadal eejaad karta hai

Garaj us ki hamd ki tasbeeh karti hai aur farishte us ke khauf se hamd o sana karte rehte hain, aur bijliyon ko bhejta hai to jis tak chaahta hai pahuncha deta hai, aur yeh log Allah ke baare mein kaj-behsi kar rahe hain jab ke woh bahut mazboot quwwat aur azeem taaqat waala hai

Barhaq pukaarna sirf Khuda hi ka pukaarna hai, aur jo log us ke ilaawa doosron ko pukaarte hain woh un ki koi baat qubool nahin kar sakte, siwaaye us shakhs ke maanind jo paani ki taraf hatheli phailaaye ho ke munh tak pahunch jaaye aur woh pahunchne waala nahin hai, aur kaafiron ki dua hamesha gumraahi mein rehti hai
Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan waale hansi khushi ya zabardasti sajda kar rahe hain, aur subh o shaam un ke saaye bhi sajda-kunaan hain

Paighambar! Keh dijiye ke batao ke zameen o aasmaan ka Parwardigar kaun hai? Aur bata dijiye ke Allah hi hai. Aur keh dijiye ke tum logon ne us ko chhod kar aise sarparast ikhtiyaar kiye hain jo khud apne nafa o nuqsaan ke maalik nahin hain. Aur kahiye ke kya andhe aur beena ek jaise ho sakte hain? Ya noor o zulmat baraabar ho sakte hain? Ya un logon ne Allah ke liye aise shareek banaaye hain jinhon ne usi ki tarah ki kaainaat khalq ki hai aur un par khilqat mushtabah ho gayi hai? Keh dijiye ke Allah hi har shai ka khaaliq hai aur wahi yakta aur sab par ghaalib hai

Us ne aasmaan se paani barsaaya to waadiyon mein ba-qadr-e-zarf behne laga, aur sailaab mein josh kha kar jhaag aa gaya, aur us dhaat se bhi jhaag paida ho gaya jise aag par zewar ya koi doosra saamaan banaane ke liye pighlaate hain. Isi tarah Parwardigar haq o baatil ki misaal bayaan karta hai ke jhaag khushk ho kar fana ho jaata hai aur jo logon ko faaida pahunchaane waala hai woh zameen mein baaqi reh jaata hai, aur Khuda isi tarah misaalein bayaan karta hai

Jo log Parwardigar ki baat ko qubool kar lete hain un ke liye neki hai, aur jo us ki baat ko qubool nahin karte inhein zameen ke saare khazaane bhi mil jaayein aur isi qadr aur bhi mil jaaye to yeh ba-taur-e-fidya de denge, lekin un ke liye badtareen hisaab hai aur un ka thikaana Jahannam hai, aur woh bahut bura thikaana hai

Kya woh shakhs jo yeh jaanta hai ke jo kuch aap ke Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil hua sab barhaq hai, woh us ke jaisa ho sakta hai jo bilkul andha hai? (Hargiz nahin) Is baat ko sirf saahibaan-e-aql hi samajh sakte hain
Jo ahd-e-Khuda ko poora karte hain aur ahd-shikani nahin karte hain
Aur jo un ta'alluqaat ko qaaim rakhte hain jinhein Khuda ne qaaim rakhne ka hukm diya hai, aur us se darte rehte hain aur badtareen hisaab se khaufzada rehte hain

Aur jinhon ne marzi-e-Khuda haasil karne ke liye sabr kiya hai aur namaaz qaaim ki hai aur hamaare rizq mein se khufiya o e'laaniya infaaq kiya hai, aur jo neki ke zariye buraai ko daf'a karte rehte hain, aakhirat ka ghar unhi ke liye hai
Yeh hamesha rehne waale baaghaat hain jin mein yeh khud aur un ke aaba o ajdaad aur azwaaj o aulaad mein se saare nek bande daakhil honge, aur malaaika un ke paas har darwaaze se haaziri denge
Kahenge ke tum par salaamati ho ke tum ne sabr kiya hai, aur ab aakhirat ka ghar tumhaari behtareen manzil hai

Aur jo log ahd-e-Khuda ko tod dete hain aur jin se ta'alluqaat ka hukm diya gaya hai un se qat'-e-ta'alluqaat kar lete hain aur zameen mein fasaad barpa karte hain, un ke liye la'nat aur badtareen ghar hai

Allah jis ke liye chaahta hai rizq ko wasee' ya tang kar deta hai, aur yeh log sirf zindagaani-e-duniya par khush ho gaye hain, haalaanke aakhirat ke muqaable mein zindagaani-e-duniya sirf ek waqti lazzat ka darja rakhti hai aur bas

Aur yeh kaafir kehte hain ke un ke oopar hamaari pasand ki nishaani kyon nahin naazil hoti? To Paighambar! Keh dijiye ke Allah jis ko chaahta hai gumraahi mein chhod deta hai aur jo us ki taraf mutawajjeh ho jaate hain inhein hidaayat de deta hai
Yeh woh log hain jo imaan laaye hain aur un ke dilon ko yaad-e-Khuda se itminaan haasil hota hai, aur aagaah ho jaao ke itminaan yaad-e-Khuda hi se haasil hota hai
Jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye un ke liye behtareen jagah (Bahisht) aur behtareen baazgasht hai

Isi tarah hum ne aap ko ek aisi qaum ke darmiyaan bheja hai jis se pehle bahut si qaumein guzar chuki hain, taake aap un cheezon ki tilaawat karein jinhein hum ne aap ki taraf ba-zariya-e-wahi naazil kiya hai, haalaanke woh log Rahmaan ka inkaar karne waale hain. Aap un se kahiye ke woh mera Rab hai aur us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, usi par mera e'temaad hai aur usi ki taraf baazgasht hai

Aur agar koi Quran aisa ho jis se pahaadon ko apni jagah se chalaaya ja sake ya zameen tai ki ja sake ya murdon se kalaam kiya ja sake, to woh yahi Quran hai. Balke tamaam umoor Allah ke liye hain. To kya imaan waalon par waazeh nahin hua ke agar Khuda jabran chaahta to saare insaanon ko hidaayat de deta? Aur in kaafiron par un ke kartoot ki bina par hamesha koi na koi museebat padti rahegi ya un ke dayaar ke aas paas museebat aati rahegi, yahaan tak ke wa'da-e-Ilaahi ka waqt aa jaaye, ke Allah apne wa'de ke khilaaf nahin karta hai
Paighambar! Aap se pehle bahut se rasoolon ka mazaaq udaaya gaya hai, to hum ne kaafiron ko thodi der ki mohlat de di aur us ke baad apni giraft mein le liya, to kaisa sakht azaab hua

Kya woh zaat jo har nafs ke aamaal ki nigraan hai? Aur unhon ne us ke liye shareek farz kar liye hain. To kahiye ke zara shurakaa ke naam to batao. Tum Khuda ko un shurakaa ki khabar de rahe ho jin ki saari zameen mein use bhi khabar nahin hai, ya faqat yeh zaahiri alfaaz hain? Aur sach to yeh hai ke kaafiron ke liye un ka makr aaraasta ho gaya hai aur inhein raah-e-haq se rok diya gaya hai, aur jise Khuda hidaayat na de us ka koi hidaayat karne waala nahin hai
Un ke liye zindagaani-e-duniya mein bhi azaab hai aur aakhirat ka azaab to aur ziyaada sakht hai, aur phir Allah se bachaane waala koi nahin hai

Jis jannat ka saahibaan-e-taqwa se wa'da kiya gaya hai us ki misaal yeh hai ke us ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi aur us ke phal daaimi honge aur saaya bhi hamesha rahega. Yeh saahibaan-e-taqwa ki aaqibat hai, aur kuffaar ka anjaam-e-kaar bahar-haal Jahannam hai

Aur jin logon ko hum ne kitaab di hai woh is tanzeel se khush hain, aur ba'z giroh woh hain jo ba'z baaton ka inkaar karte hain. To aap keh dijiye ke mujhe yeh hukm diya gaya hai ke main Allah ki ibaadat karoon aur kisi ko us ka shareek na banaaoon. Main usi ki taraf daawat deta hoon aur usi ki taraf sab ki baazgasht hai

Aur isi tarah hum ne is Quran ko Arabi zabaan ka farmaan bana kar naazil kiya hai, aur agar aap ilm ke aa jaane ke baad un ki khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' kar lenge to Allah ke muqaable mein koi kisi ka sarparast aur bachaane waala na hoga

Hum ne aap se pehle bhi bahut se rasool bheje hain aur un ke liye azwaaj aur aulaad qaraar di hai, aur kisi rasool ke liye yeh mumkin nahin hai ke woh Allah ki ijaazat ke baghair koi nishaani le aaye, ke har muddat aur mee'aad ke liye ek navishta muqarrar hai
Allah jis cheez ko chaahta hai mita deta hai ya barqaraar rakhta hai, ke asl kitaab usi ke paas hai
Aur ae Paighambar! Hum kuffaar se kiye wa'da-e-azaab ko tumhein dikhla dein ya tumhein utha lein, tumhaara kaam to sirf ahkaam ka pahuncha dena hai, hisaab ki zimmedaari hamaari apni hai

Kya un logon ne nahin dekha ke hum kis tarah zameen ki taraf aa kar us ko atraaf se kam kar dete hain? Aur Allah hi hukm dene waala hai, koi us ke hukm ka taalne waala nahin hai, aur woh bahut tez hisaab karne waala hai

Aur un se pehle waalon ne bhi makr kiya hai, lekin saari tadbeerein Allah hi ke ikhtiyaar mein hain. Woh har nafs ke kaarobaar ko jaanta hai, aur anqareeb kuffaar bhi jaan lenge ke aakhirat ka ghar kis ke liye hai

Aur yeh kaafir kehte hain ke aap rasool nahin hain. Keh dijiye ke hamaare aur tumhaare darmiyaan risaalat ki gawaahi ke liye Khuda kaafi hai, aur woh shakhs kaafi hai jis ke paas poori kitaab ka ilm hai
